subject: Eval gate timeline reset & ownership roster
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Timeline update for evaluation cadence

Hi Sofia,

Quick heads-up from our side: the internal evaluation committee at Nimbus has pushed the governance review due to a scheduling conflict — they moved the decision gate from 10/29 to 11/12. That shifts our close runway and compresses procurement.

Procurement also flagged a month-end PO approval blackout (11/16–11/20) that may affect contract signing if we don't get canary & compliance evidence in the next two weeks.

Can you share an updated MAP with clearly assigned owners and escalation triggers? We need to know: 1) who owns SOC2/controls evidence, 2) who will run the canary/POQ, and 3) a contingency if the exec sign-off slips again.

Thanks — Jane
Jane Doe
VP Product, Nimbus Health
[jane.doe@nimbushealth.com]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline update for evaluation cadence

Jane — thanks for the quick update.

We can accommodate the 11/12 decision gate but will need to re-baseline the MAP and lock owners for the high-risk items you called out. I'm attaching an initial walk-through and a versioned MAP (v2) with proposed owners and dates. Highlights: 

- SOC2 evidence: deliverable owner = Laura Bennett (security org) — target 10/26 for draft evidence; 11/05 final.
- Canaries/POQ: owner = Ben Carter (solutions lead) — canary runs w/c 10/26 and final validation 11/08.
- Procurement coordination: primary contact = Alan Torres (cc'd).
- Contingency: if exec delay beyond 11/12, trigger an exec readout and credit/extension ask by 11/16.

I attached the MAP draft and a short risks doc. Can you confirm Alan and procurement's availability for a 30-min sync next week? If you confirm, I will circulate an ownership roster and an escalation matrix.

Attachments: [Attachment: NIMB_MAP_v2.xlsx]

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
[Attachment: NIMB_MAP_v2.xlsx]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Nimbus MAP — owners, risks, and escalation triggers (action items)

Team — bringing this internal to capture clear owners and due dates after Jane's note. We need concise deliverables and a playbook if the gate slips further. Please reply with a one-line ack + your single-point owner for the items below.

Current ask and proposed owners/dates:
- SOC2 evidence package (controls matrix + evidence links) — owner: Laura — draft 10/26; final 11/05.
- Canary validation + performance budget (latency/cost) — owner: Ben — canary week 10/26; final validation 11/08.
- Fallback model plan (lower-cost quantized variant if latency issues) — owner: Marcus — prototype by 10/30.
- Commercial terms & PO acceptance window (pricing & credit options) — owner: Rishi — pricing brief 10/22; credit recommendation by 11/09 if needed.

Escalation policy (proposed):
- Trigger A: If SOC2 evidence not delivered by 11/05 => immediate exec readout and proposed 30-day extension + partial credit.
- Trigger B: If canary fails on perf metrics during 11/08 validation => fallback to quantized model + rolling canary; notify Marcus to execute.
- Trigger C: If procurement flags PO blackout (11/16–11/20) — we open contract negotiation for e-sign window or escrow.

Action items (reply by 10/19 COB):
- Laura: confirm SOC2 evidence contents and any blockers.
- Ben: confirm canary infra needs and whether dedicated capacity is required.
- Marcus: declare fallback model readiness and approximate latency uplift.
- Rishi: prepare credit/term options we can offer if we need to extend.

I'll collate replies and send versioned MAP v3 to Nimbus after we have confirmations.

Thanks — Sofia

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Torres <alan.torres@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-10-23T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline update for evaluation cadence

Sofia — thanks for the clear plan. Alan and I are available for a 30-min sync on 10/27 at 10:00am PT. Procurement confirmed the blackout window — it is firm.

Two clarifications: 
1) The exec decision on 11/12 is tentative; we have a rolling agenda item and might still push by a week.
2) For canary, Nimbus requires a performance baseline document tied to specific usage slices (telemetry ingestion). Can Ben include that in the canary runbook?

If you can send MAP v3 after your internal confirmations, we'll aim to lock owners on the 10/27 sync.

—Jane

Date: 2026-11-02T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: MAP v3 (finalized owners) + timeline reset and escalation note

Team — following our internal confirmations and the 10/27 sync, attached is MAP v3 (final) and a short risk appendix. Summary of the re-baselined timeline and hard owners below: 

- 10/26–11/05: SOC2 evidence package — owner: Laura Bennett — deliverable: controls matrix, evidence links.
- 10/26–11/08: Canary runs & performance baseline — owner: Ben Carter — deliverable: canary runbook + telemetry baseline.
- 10/30: Fallback model prototype (quantized variant) — owner: Marcus Lin.
- 11/05: Procurement terms and contract window confirmed — owner: Rishi Malhotra.
- 11/12: Exec decision gate (target) — Nimbus decision owners: Jane + Alan.
- Escalation triggers: as discussed — see EXPO trigger matrix in appendix.

Attachments: [Attachment: NIMB_MAP_v3.xlsx], [Attachment: nimbus-risk-dependencies.pdf], [Attachment: SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf]

Important notes: 
- Because of the procurement blackout (11/16–11/20), if the exec decision slips beyond 11/12 we will need to request a signing exception or pre-authorize an e-sign window. Rishi, please prepare a short credit/term play we can offer (up to two weeks) should signing fall into the blackout.
- We will schedule an executive readout for Nov 9 to pre-empt a 2nd slip. That readout will include live canary results and SOC2 evidence draft.

Next steps (requested): 
- Laura: confirm SOC2 package readiness by 11/05 COB.
- Ben: deliver canary runbook and telemetry baseline by 11/08.
- Marcus: provide latency delta and rollback plan by 10/30.
- Rishi: submit term/credit brief by 11/09.

If any of you cannot meet these dates, flag now so I can adjust triggers.

Thanks — Sofia
[Attachments: NIMB_MAP_v3.xlsx, nimbus-risk-dependencies.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-09T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Exec readout summary and escalation decision (Nov 9)

Team / Jane — quick summary after today's executive readout:

- Execs at Nimbus confirmed they will keep the 11/12 decision gate but requested a 48-hour window to finalize legal wording.
- Canary run (Ben) met latency and cost thresholds on the 11/08 validation; telemetry baseline attached.
- SOC2 evidence (Laura) is marked "draft-complete"; security wants two additional artifact links by 11/12.
- Procurement flagged that if legal needs more than the 48-hour window we will likely hit the 11/16 blackout. We should be prepared to offer a 7-day credit or a short signing extension.

Escalation decision taken: 
- If exec decision slips past 11/14 => auto-trigger credit approval up to 7 days; Rishi to prepare details and pre-clear finance.
- If SOC2 final artifacts are not provided by 11/12 17:00 PT => pause auto-provision and schedule an immediate remediation call.

Next items: 
- Rishi: please circulate the credit/term options and confirm finance pre-clear by 11/10 COB.
- Laura: post the two remaining artifacts to the evidence folder by 11/12 17:00 PT.
- Ben: stand by for canary replay if telemetry shows regressions; keep logs for the exec archive.
